VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: A=∅, P=∅: forward direction vacuous (no classes, union empty, claims hold vacuously), converse ∼_P is empty relation, quotient set ∅, uniqueness holds.
BOUNDARY: A nonempty, P empty: impossible by partition definition (union would be empty).
BOUNDARY: A singleton, P={A}: forward and converse both hold.
BOUNDARY: A with discrete partition (P singletons): forward (equality relation) and converse consistent.
BOUNDARY: A with trivial partition (P={A}): forward (universal relation) and converse consistent.
BOUNDARY: infinite set, arbitrary partition: no hidden assumptions; proof constructions are valid without choice.
